name: Orthogonal
tagline: One key + one balance for 60+ providers / ~1,000 endpoints (search, scraping, enrichment, market/social data) via API, MCP, CLI
status_notes: Active (YC-backed). Closest product-shape match to o11: discover → inspect → quote → run.
backers: $4.3M seed (June 2026) led by Pantera Capital with Y Combinator, Pioneer Fund, Decasonic, Blast, Outbound, Surreal

pricing.platform_fee: 5% processing fee on credit top-ups ($25 credits = $26.25)
pricing.notes: Per-endpoint listed prices (fixed or request-dependent). $1 one-time starter credit for eligible verified agent signups.

spend_controls.notes: No per-agent budget/allowlist controls documented in skill.md or homepage; checkout links require user approval; balance/usage endpoints.

setup_steps_to_first_call: Paste orthogonal.com/skill.md into coding agent, or npm i -g @orth/cli && orth login (or device-code agent signup with email+phone verify)
Fund credits (or pay per call via x402/MPP)
orth search '<need>' → orth api show → orth run --dry-run → orth run

public_endpoints_probed.result: 200 unauthenticated; count=66 APIs, totalEndpoints=954, protocols x402/mpp/np

strengths: Unauthenticated machine-readable catalog with schemas + prices (/discover, /openapi.json)
Multi-rail: card credits plus x402, MPP, nanopayments
MCP, CLI, SDK, REST, skill.md parity
weaknesses: No documented per-agent caps, allowlists or approvals
No idempotency — docs tell agents to check usage before retrying

sources.claim: 60+ providers, 1,000+ endpoints; quote; no monthly subscription; x402/MPP/nanopayments; $4.3M Pantera; YC
CLI/SDK/MCP/REST; quote; 5% fee; $1 starter credit; retry guidance; rails
